answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the prism of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the dawn of a task receipt, and the basalt is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
